# Elizabeth Kirk

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER XXI. THE IMPOSSIBLE WORD P4](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0004)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) (cousin)

## Appearance

Elizabeth Kirk possesses a gentle and unpretentious visage. She is also described as being genuinely plain.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER VII. A FISHY EPISODE P34](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0034), [v5 CHAPTER XXI. THE IMPOSSIBLE WORD P4](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0004)_

## Personality

Elizabeth Kirk is a good and extremely pleasant individual who is beloved by all. She is known for showing kindness to children and willingness to undertake the role of a stepmother when no one else desires the task.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER VII. A FISHY EPISODE P34](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0034), [v5 CHAPTER VII. A FISHY EPISODE P35](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0035), [v5 CHAPTER XXVIII. A FAST DAY P26](../source/v05-c28.md#nw-v05-c28-p0026)_
